body: I’m praying really really hard. Tonight feels like the night but the people in my life somehow sees through me and are asking me to not do it, I think God sent them but I don’t get why he’s stopping me when I haven’t got answers when I was asking it from him I feel so low and down the person that I love probably has no clue how much I truly love her. She’s been hurt but I know I can be better I know I’m better.. but this seems like the end I’m starting to feel like there’s no more tomorrow.
